tags.name: Lore
tags.notes: The backdrop was a truck driving across America animated as a giant, elaborate diorama presented by hands animated in the same style.

tags.name: Lore
tags.notes: Visuals depicted a journey through an MC Escher-esque landscape of surreal "rooms" that ranged from a cozy fireplace to a giant cat peering in through the window, ultimately emerging in Las Vegas.

tags.name: Tease
tags.notes: Theme from Speed Racer by Nobuyoshi Koshibe

tags.name: Banter
tags.transcript: TREY: Welcome back, everybody, so happy to be back here. Thank you for being here.

tags.name: Lore
tags.notes: The perspective shifted to the earth beneath a forest, a scene made up of tiny dots which glowed and pulsed together. As the jam progressed, furniture and rooms began to appear in the forest, with the scene ultimately morphing into an image of the band.

tags.name: Lore
tags.notes: The visuals culminated in a recreation of David Welker's cover art for the album.

tags.name: Tease
tags.notes: Somewhere Over the Rainbow by Harold Arlen and E.Y. Harburg

tags.name: Lore
tags.notes: Visuals began with giant, sneaker-clad legs running in different directions while stepping on piles of goo on the ground, sticking to their shoes. This became a world with both aquatic and surface aspects, with stars and fish, plant and animal life, some of whom developed goo bubbles and started to rise. The entire scene ultimately melted back into a puddle with a confused face.

tags.name: Lore
tags.notes: The licking dog (from April 19, 2024) returned during the vocal jam, followed by a jam against an ocean of dogs swimming in sudsy water with goggles on, and finally wiener dogs in hot dog costumes.

tags.name: Lore
tags.notes: The hot dog theme continued by flying through a warehouse floor full of hot dogs to a hot dog rocket ship, which blasted into an outerspace littered with donuts and other snack foods. The ship ultimately found a planet with a hot dog population worshiping a giant monolith-like hot dog with a volcano erupting in the distance.

tags.name: Banter
tags.transcript: TREY: Thanks so much everybody, thank you.

tags.name: Bustout
tags.notes: First performance of Space Oddity in 168 shows

tags.name: Lore
tags.notes: Culminated in a virtual fireworks display.

tags.name: Banter
tags.transcript: TREY: Thank you so much everybody, thank you for coming. We'll see you tomorrow night, be safe. Thank you.
